author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Fidelity Investments has opened a new waterfront headquarters at Commonwealth Pier in Boston’s Seaport while requiring more than 6,000 Boston-based employees to work in person five days a week. The move ends a hybrid policy that had allowed employees to work remotely for roughly half of each month.

The new headquarters spans about 735,000 square feet and was designed around shared work and collaboration areas. Fidelity is also retaining its approximately 855,000-square-foot building at 245 Summer Street, a change from earlier plans to offer that downtown property for lease. Keeping both sites gives the company room for daily attendance across its large local workforce.

The decision matters beyond one employer because downtown and Seaport offices continue to work through elevated vacancy after the pandemic reshaped commuting patterns. Fidelity’s combined Boston footprint now approaches 1.6 million square feet across the two buildings. The Commonwealth Pier redevelopment also includes public-facing retail and museum space, connecting the private headquarters project to the waterfront district. For employees, however, the most immediate change is straightforward: the new workplace opens alongside a return to a full five-day office schedule.
dek: The financial-services company is keeping its Summer Street building while opening a 735,000-square-foot Seaport headquarters.
headline: Fidelity opens Seaport headquarters as Boston staff return five days a week
